messages:
Omar: quick sketch for a regional-first canary plan for the routing-policy change. goal: minimize blast radius, keep billing and quality telemetry per-tenant, and make rollback trivial. comments?
Priya: love the regional-first idea. suggest phases: 1) internal canary w/ chaos spike, 2) single-region pilot (EU-west), 3) staggered region ramp (EU->US->APAC), 4) global. each stage has a gating window (default 36h) + health checks.
Kai: ops constraints: we need an opt-in toggle per-tenant and a visible pilot badge on the console. opt-in/out must be immediate (no bake). also want an opt-out webhook so CS can flip for customers.
Hannah: metrics to signal: p95 latency, spike-initiated tail latency (99th for large prompts), 5xx rate, model-output drift score (auto-eval), and cost-per-req. quick thresholds in my head: p95 <= baseline+25ms, 99th <= baseline+100ms, 5xx delta <= 0.2%.
Omar: proposed flag config snippet (conceptual):
```yaml
flag: routing_v2
scopes: [global, region, tenant]
phase: internal|pilot|staggered|global
decay: 7d
kill_switch: POST /internal/admin/flags/routing_v2/kill
```
Kai: implementation note: make flavor fallback explicit: routing_v2 -> routing_v1-compatible-variant so we don't hit incompatible model ops. fallback should preserve model size and quantization whenever possible.
Priya: experiment design: randomize at tenant level, keep cohorts stable for at least 24h. For the pilot region, pick 5 low-risk tenants + 1 mid-risk. measure both aggregated regional metrics and per-tenant deltas. stop criteria: any tenant with p95 > gate or >2x baseline incident count in 6h.
Hannah: telemetry work: need dashboards that show cohort overlays and per-tenant drilldowns. also want a synthetic probe that sends both short and long prompts every 5m and reports tail percentiles separately.
Omar: runbook excerpt:
- Alert fires -> oncall ack -> triage (15m) -> if confirmed breach, hit kill_switch -> notify pilot customers + open postmortem.
SRE-bot: :warning: simulated chaos job scheduled for internal canary Wednesday 03:00 UTC. job id: chaos-420.
Kai: customer comms: we'll provide a pilot opt-in page with clear rollback SLA (48h response + 2 business day rollback window). CS owner: Priya.
Priya: I'll draft copy and the opt-in page prototype. also will coordinate the first pilot tenants.
Hannah: small ask: log flag-roll events to an audit stream and surface recent flips in the console (so customers see if we changed routing for them).
Omar: owners / next actions:
- Kai: tenant opt-in toggle + webhook (JIRA INF-2401)
- Hannah: dashboards + synthetic probes (JIRA OBS-789)
- Priya: customer comms + opt-in page (JIRA CS-211)
- Omar: rollout orchestration + gating rules (JIRA PROD-502)
deploy-bot: :rocket: rollout task created for Thu 09:00 UTC. task: rollout-2400.
Priya: timeline check: internal canary Tue, pilot Wed (EU-west), staggered ramp next week if green.
Kai: oncall, please standby for the chaos window. I'll post the exact spike plan in #eng-oncall.
Omar: thanks all. if no objections by EOD today I'll lock the phased schedule and start the playbook doc.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: rollout-2400 created and awaiting manual start.
